subject: Security exhibit: pen-test window, SOC 2 evidence cadence, and order form tie-in
messages:
From: Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@clearhealth.com>
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@clearhealth.com, security@clearhealth.com
Date: Mon, 8 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Quick clarifications on security exhibit + pen test window

Priya / Laura —

Thanks for sending over the draft MSA + order form. Security team had a couple of follow-ups specific to the security exhibit before procurement can finalize: 

1) Pen test timing: we need clarity on the allowed windows and the process for requesting privileged accounts during the test. Can you confirm whether pen tests require a dedicated maintenance window and whether Redwood provides a PoV (proof-of-vulnerability) reporting format?

2) SOC 2 evidence: we typically collect a short SOC 2 summary and the auditor contact. Can you confirm whether Redwood will provide a Type II summary and an expected cadence for evidence refresh?

3) Audit rights: our legal team wants a short paragraph on reasonable scope for on-site/remote evidence requests and a 48-hour notice for anything that requires privileged access. Is that acceptable?

We're trying to lock this in this week so procurement can route the order form. Happy to set a 30-minute sync if that's easier.

—Tom
Tom Rivera
Director, Security & Compliance
ClearHealth

From: priya_natarajan@redwood.com
To: Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@clearhealth.com>, procurement@clearhealth.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 8 Feb 2027 10:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick clarifications on security exhibit + pen test window

Tom —

Appreciate the clear list. High level answers below and I attached a redline of the security exhibit for the MSA + a one-page SOC 2 summary. Proposed next steps and timeline at the bottom.

1) Pen test timing & privileged access
- Redwood supports both scheduled maintenance windows and a pre-approved continuous window for scoped pen tests. For third-party pen testers we require an access request form (attached) and a signed rules-of-engagement.
- We can accommodate a 4-hour dedicated window during non-peak hours or a multi-day window for more complex tests. Privileged account requests must be submitted at least 72 hours in advance; for urgent windows we can make exceptions but require a written escalation and cross-team approval.
- PoV format: we provide a simple template (findings, impact, repro steps, remediation status). We'll accept PoV in CSV/markdown/PDF.

2) SOC 2 evidence cadence
- We are happy to provide a SOC 2 Type II summary (attached). Full report delivery is governed by our confidentiality terms; customers with an executed NDA/order form can request the full report through a secure portal.
- Evidence refresh: we publish an annual SOC 2 at minimum and can provide targeted evidence (logs, control maps) on a quarterly basis if the customer has standard review needs. For ongoing customers with an annual audit, we recommend a quarterly evidence cadence to avoid burst requests.

3) Audit rights & notice
- We propose language that allows remote evidence requests and scoped on-site reviews with a 48–72 hour notice for privileged access. For broader forensic on-site audits, we request a mutually agreed statement of scope and at least 10 business days' notice.

Proposed timeline (we can compress as needed):
- Tue/Wed: You review the redline I attached and highlight any hard blockers.
- Thu: 30-min sync to resolve open points (if needed).
- Fri: Finalize security exhibit + attach to order form for procurement signature.

Attachments: Redwood_Security_Exhibit_v3_redlines.pdf; SOC2-TypeII-2026-summary.pdf; PenTest_Access_Request_Form.docx

If that plan works, I'll loop in Legal for a final read once you call out any redline counters.

Thanks —
Priya Natarajan
Head of Enterprise Sales (Security & Compliance motion)
Redwood Inference

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@clearhealth.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 9 Feb 2027 11:23:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick clarifications on security exhibit + pen test window

Tom / Priya —

Quick add from Legal/Trust: two operational clarifications that would help speed procurement: 
- Evidence delivery channel: we'll provide SOC 2 artifacts through a secure link (DocuSign/secure portal). Please confirm which stakeholder will receive the link; recommended is "security@clearhealth.com" and procurement as CC.
- Pen test scope: to avoid open-ended rights, we prefer a scoped list of systems/IPs and an explicit timebox. If ClearHealth can provide a short scope table we can insert it as Appendix A and we will honor that scope.

If both are OK, I can draft the language and push the redline back by EOD.

—Karthik Iyer
Head, Legal – Redwood Inference

From: priya_natarajan@redwood.com
To: Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@clearhealth.com>, procurement@clearhealth.com, security@clearhealth.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick clarifications on security exhibit + pen test window

Tom —

Thanks — great Qs and appreciate the speed. Confirming next steps: 

- Tom / ClearHealth: please send the short pen-test scope table (systems, IP ranges, preferred window) by EOD Thursday so we can lock Appendix A.
- Priya/Legal (Karthik): you'll push a redline update that adds: (a) explicit Appendix A placeholder, (b) 72-hour standard privileged-access notice with a 10-business-day forensic audit clause, (c) secure delivery channel note for SOC 2 artifacts. Target EOD Thursday for the redline.
- Once redline is agreed, procurement will receive the final exhibit + order form link for signature.

I've attached the same artifacts again and included a Drive link to a staging folder where we will deposit evidence once the order is executed.

If anyone prefers a 20-min call instead of back-and-forth, I can host at 9am PT Friday. Otherwise we'll proceed with the timeline above.

Best —
Priya Natarajan
Head of Enterprise Sales (Security & Compliance motion)
Redwood Inference
